video:video.video:title: Superdock giving each Chrome profile its own Dock icon
video:video.video:description: Chrome runs every profile in one process, so macOS shows one Dock icon for all of them. Superdock gives each profile its own icon with that profile's avatar, hover previews of only that profile's windows, and clickable space beside the dock for Mission Control or Stage Manager.

video:video.video:title: Work, personal and design Chrome profiles as separate Dock icons
video:video.video:description: Clicking a profile's Dock icon brings that profile's own window forward, and hovering it previews only that profile's windows.

video:video.video:title: The Superdock window switcher showing every open window
video:video.video:description: Holding Option-Tab to show every open window as a picture, including minimised windows that Command-Tab skips.

video:video.video:title: Clicking beside the dock to open Mission Control or Stage Manager
video:video.video:description: Clicking the wallpaper to the right of the dock opens Mission Control and to the left opens Stage Manager, with no hot corner and no keyboard shortcut.

video:video.video:title: A Superdock dock on each of two displays
video:video.video:description: A dock on each of two displays, each showing the apps whose windows are open on that screen. Dragging a window across moves its icon to the other dock.
